target_customer: Gene therapy developers, especially rare disease programs needing clinical grade vectors
problem: Gene therapy manufacturing needs large facilities, labor and regulatory work, making rare disease targets uneconomic.
business_model: Automated robotic lab producing gene therapies for clinical trials, likely service revenue; not confirmed

founders.name: Omid Karkouti
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page; team size 2 but the second person is not named there.

technical_complexity.rationale: Automating gene therapy vector manufacturing for clinical use combines robotics, biology and regulatory requirements, which a two person team could not realistically complete.

defensibility.rationale: GMP compliance and process know how would be hard to copy if achieved, but nothing was shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent reaction found; the company went inactive.

market_need_then: Gene therapy sponsors faced scarce manufacturing capacity per the company description; no independent dated evidence was gathered.

branding.domain_note: Used perception.bio; the site returned HTTP 503 when fetched.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; name resembles many similar biotech names.

outcome_analysis: Perception Biosystems was a two person Summer 2018 team trying to automate gene therapy manufacturing. Public sources show almost no activity beyond the YC listing, which marks it inactive. No shutdown cause is public, so the cause is not known and no failure factors are assigned.
notes: The 120K figure and an out of business date of February 2022 come from a single lesser known directory (healthcarediscovery.ai), unverified; Seedtable shows no rounds and no Form D was found. Database names Reformer Therapeutics and Perception Therapeutics appear in some entries and may be a mix up. The website returned 503. No dated competitors found; Cellares and Ori Biotech results were not from the batch period.
